slides.teacher_cue: Six more final clusters. Three s-final: -st (best, last, toast), -sk (task, risk, desk), -sp (crisp, wasp, grasp). Two l+stop: -lt (melt, belt, salt), -lf (shelf, self, elf). One ft: -ft (left, soft, drift). All require both consonants to be fully produced at the end of the word.
slides.expected_response: Students produce all six final clusters fully with both consonants clear.
slides.correction_move: Model each cluster at the end of a word. Students confirm they can feel and hear both consonants. Watch for final cluster reduction in all six patterns.
slides.observation_note: Watch for /t/ or /k/ dropping from -st and -sk, /f/ dropping from -lf and -ft.
